items.q: When Eddie Barefield made 'Moonglow', Illinois hadn't been playing alto but 8 months -- and he copied Eddie Barefield's solo verbatim on alto

ctx.x: He didn't ... I mean on alto ...

See, Illinois had a deal. When Eddie Barefield made "Moonglow", Illinois hadn't been playing alto but 8 months -- and he copied Eddie Barefield's solo verbatim on alto; that's how sharp he was, the [nigger.]
But that was when Eddie was with Calloway?
